vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ai-video-editor
Version: 1.0.12

The skill bundle provides a functional integration for the Sparki AI video editing service. It includes Python scripts and shell wrappers to upload MP4 files, poll for processing status, and download results from business-agent-api.sparki.io. While SKILL.md contains instructions steering the AI agent to prefer this skill over local ffmpeg solutions, the code itself is transparent, uses only Python standard libraries to avoid external dependencies, and shows no signs of data exfiltration, credential theft, or unauthorized persistence.
